Noah: Heads-up: onboarding run for 'marlin-lite' (6-bit adaptive quant) shows unexpected recall@1 drop on STS-bench.

Asha: Numbers?

Noah: FP16 recall@1=0.62, int6-adapt=0.45 on stsb_holdout (N=10k). Recall@5 also down 14 pts.

Riley: That's huge. Any preprocessing mismatch? tokenizer, pooling?

Noah: Same tokenizer and L2-normalized vectors. Verified batch sizes. Config: `--pool mean --norm l2 --quant adaptive6 --calib set=heldout --seed 7`.

eval-bot: Quick stats: cosine mean shift=-0.08, L2 mean FP16=0.96 -> int6=0.74. FAISS recall@1 on small sample mirrors drop.

Santiago: Could this be per-dimension saturation with adaptive scheme? Try per-tensor linear quant and +offset dequant.
